content.rendered:
The budget committee consists of five members appointed by the Board, plus the elected Board members. The committee has the responsibility for reviewing the financial program of the district, reviewing the proposed district budget as presented by the superintendent, and recommending an annual or biennial district budget in keeping with the provisions of applicable state laws.

2025-26 Budget Committee Members

Position 1: Ryan Dunlap
